ITEM 1 | Four to five cubes of pale off-white solid food with matte, slightly porous surface and soft-looking edges, each cube about 2.5 cm per side, clustered on the left side of the plate with no visible sauce or browning | 60
ITEM 2 | Single wedge-shaped piece of baked flatbread with golden-orange browned crust edges, a bubbly reddish-orange tomato-colored layer, and melted pale yellow cheese with light brown spots in the center, about 8 cm long and 1 cm thick, slightly oily sheen, sitting alone on the lower right of the plate | 90
